Be heard with the Razer Seiren V2 Pro and Seiren V2 X


Razer has announced the addition of two new models into its award-winning line of broadcaster microphones in the Seiren V2 Pro and Seiren V2 X. Enjoy premium feature sets within dynamic and condenser microphones to deliver true to life, natural audio capture.



Get best-in-class rich, powerful vocals to showcase the depth and timber in your voice, with radio-DJ tonal quality through the Seiren V2 Pro. Thanks to high pass filters and analog gain limiters, you can be sure the mics will only capture what you intend it to, filtering out any extra noise. Some of the features it boasts include:

20 Hz Frequency Response to Capture Full Range of Audio
High Pass Filter to Block Out Unwanted Low Frequencies
Analog Gain Limiter to Prevent Voice Distortion
Superior Dynamic Range and Precision with 24 Bit Rate


Meanwhile, the Seiren V2 X is an improved Seiren X, an excellent choice for a budding streamer. Featuring supercardioid pickup patterns, the Seiren V2 X can easily isolate the streamer’s voice from the background noise, delivering only what the audience wants to hear. Core features include:

Supercardioid Pickup Pattern for Greater Voice Isolation
Analog Gain Limiter to Prevent Voice Distortion
Superior Dynamic Range and Precision with 24 Bit Rate

Both the Razer Seiren V2 Pro and Seiren V2 X offers near limitless options of enhanced customization and direct integration with audio mixing software via Razer Synapse. Independently adjust control of input / output levels from multiple audio sources to deliver the sound you want to your audience.
Both the Seiren V2 Pro and Seiren V2 X have near limitless options of enhanced customization and control through direct integration with audio mixing software within Razer Synapse. Streamers can enjoy unparalleled independently adjustable control of input/output levels of multiple audio sources, in order to fully adjust the sound delivered to their audience verses the audio they hear while streaming.
The Seiren V2 Pro is available at $149.99 USD / €159.99 MSRP. The Seiren V2 X is available at $99.99 USD / €109.99 MSRP. Both can be gotten through the Razer website, RazerStores and authorized retailers.

reference_summary: Razer telah memperkenalkan Seiren V2 Pro dan Seiren V2 X, dua mikrofon baharu untuk penstrim. Seiren V2 Pro ialah mikrofon dinamik yang menyampaikan vokal yang kaya dan kuat dengan tindak balas frekuensi 20 Hz dan penapis lulus tinggi untuk menyekat frekuensi rendah yang tidak diingini. Ia juga mempunyai pengehad keuntungan analog untuk mengelakkan herotan suara dan julat dinamik yang hebat dengan kadar 24-bit. Seiren V2 Ia juga mempunyai penghad keuntungan analog dan kadar 24-bit untuk julat dinamik yang unggul. Kedua-dua mikrofon menawarkan penyesuaian yang dipertingkatkan dan penyepaduan langsung dengan perisian pencampuran audio melalui Razer Synapse.
